description.text: Introduction The program will not only benefit the development of the higher medical education, but also improve the cultural exchange and co-operation among the medical universities around the globe. IMU provides South Asian teachers especially from Pakistan,India and Nepal with MBBS and BDS program so as to provide high quality education, advanced teaching equipments, co-operative administration and innovative teaching methodology. The courses include: 1. Public courses: Chinese (intensive reading, listening and oral Chinese), brief introduction of China, healthy education. 2. Basic specialized courses: System Anatomy, Histology and Embryology, Physiology, Biochemistry,Cell Biology, Microbiology, Immunology, Pathology, Path physiology, Medical Genetics, Nutrition, Pharmacology, Social Medicine, Preventive Medicine, Local Anatomy, Health Statistics, Parasitological,Traditional Chinese Medicine. 3. Specialized courses: Diagnostics, Medical Imaging, Forensic Medicine, Clinical Immunology, Internal Medicine, Surgery, Emergency Medicine, Clinical Anesthesiology, Epidemiology, Ophthalmology, Oral Sciences, Pediatrics, Psychiatry, Neurology, Infectious Diseases, Skin Epidemiology, Otolaryngology, Obstetrics and Gynecology. 4. Practice: fundamental medicine basic skills experiments, clinical fundamental skills practice, clinical practice. Degree Awarded Students are required to complete the curriculum and course, fulfill the designated number of credits.Successful candidates will receive a graduation certificate along with the Master's degree, in accordance to the regulation of the Degree Awarding Committee.

duration.text: The MBBS in Inner Mongolia University at Inner Mongolia University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1888 USD/per year ￥ 13600 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Physical Examination Form of Foreigners (copies whith the applicant's photo on them are acceptable) 2. Certificate of the latest degree (copies are acceptable) 3. Grades (marks) report of the latest degree (copies are acceptable) 4. Copy of passport 5. 4 photograph (same size and standard as on the passport)

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizen in good health 2. Applicants are not enrolled in any other Chinese universities
